owner: Odessy (product declaration). The Harness side owns the runtime; this file is the declaration the Odessy build and installer read.
purpose: One repository-owned declaration of the tested Harness runtime distribution, the SDK (declared, not used), the plugin closure that ships with the Odessy package, the platform/architecture requirements and the licences. `pin.py` derives its enforced constants from this file, so there is no second copy to drift.

runtime.transport: acp v1 over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout)

manylinux_2_28_aarch64.note: Downloaded and hashed only. Never launched on this host; a Jetson/Linux qualification is a later installed gate, not evidence recorded here.

python_dependencies.note: Wheels the runtime-bin distribution pulls in, recorded with their digests so an installer resolves the same set. Installing them belongs to prompt 14.

sdk.note: The production adapter speaks ACP to the executable and never imports this SDK. It is declared so that a future use cannot silently pick a different version; pyproject.toml does not depend on it.

bundles.name: @odessy/dsh-stream-bridge
bundles.purpose: Forwards the pin's existing `agent/assistant-stream` frames and answers its existing `user-questions` seam over one token-authenticated loopback socket. No inference, no agent loop, no transcript.
bundles.absent_effect: The engine degrades to settlement-only text and no clarification tool; session creation still succeeds.

mounted_rows.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user
mounted_rows.purpose: The model-facing clarification tool; it asks a human and returns the answer as an ordinary tool result.

development_toolchain.purpose: `dsh plugin add` shells out to pnpm. The composed profile is what ships, so this is a build/developer prerequisite only.

windows-x64.qualification: source + pinned-runtime smoke on this repository's checkout; installed-application qualification is prompt 16

declared_not_qualified.linux-arm64: Runtime wheel recorded; no launch, no confinement measurement and no installed gate performed on this host (prompt 17-20 for remote directions).

confinement.owner: Odessy providers keep the dimensions the pin cannot express; see doc/reports/08.md and harness/sandbox.py.

procedure: Record both wheel digests and the new executable digest here and in pin.py's derived constants.
Re-read every observed shape in the integration contract.
Re-run the installed qualification before any default change.
